# Change auto accumulate services to be map instead of array

## Pull Request by @mateuszsikora

It is defined as a dictionary in GP: https://graypaper.fluffylabs.dev/#/1c979cb/117102117102?v=0.7.1 and we transform it to a `Map` anyway in accumulation

## Walkthrough

The PR replaces the AutoAccumulate/array representation with Map<ServiceId, ServiceGas> across the codebase. Changes touch PrivilegedServices (field type and Codec), PartialState and PartialStateMock signatures, accumulate logic and AccumulateData constructors, externalities and host-call flows (bless/updatePrivilegedServices), JSON dump/load schema, in-memory state initialization, tests, and utilities (lazyInspect). The AutoAccumulate type and related imports were removed and replaced by Map usage and adjusted logging/assertions.

🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~25 minutes

- Files/areas needing extra attention:

  - packages/jam/transition/externalities/accumulate-externalities.ts and host-call tests/mocks — signature/behavior changes and test expectations
  - packages/jam/state-json/dump.ts and state initialization paths — JSON schema and state reconstruction changes

`73-90`: **LGTM! Correct Map initialization and population.**

The refactoring from array to `Map<ServiceId, ServiceGas>` correctly:
- Initializes an empty Map (line 73)
- Populates entries using `set()` in the loop (line 87)
- Maintains insertion order (ES6 Map specification)
- Properly handles duplicate serviceIds with overwrite semantics (dictionary behavior per Graypaper)

This aligns with the PR objective to match the Graypaper dictionary definition.

---

`96-96`: **LGTM! Consistent use of lazyInspect for Map logging.**
